subject: Cobalt Therapeutics - MSA/Order Form: DPA and SCCs clarifications
messages:
From: Sara Khan <sara.khan@cobaltthera.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: procure@cobaltthera.com
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial DPA questions and hosting constraints for MSA/Order Form

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for sending the MSA and draft order form earlier today. Our legal and procurement teams reviewed and have a handful of DPA/GDPR items that are blocking internal sign-off:

- We need the explicit SCCs reference (customer requires the EU Commission SCCs 2021 template) included in the DPA, and a short transfer impact addendum that documents the assessment outcome for transfers to US-hosted infra.
- Cobalt operates in Switzerland and the EU; please confirm whether Redwood’s hosted model will rely on EU regions or US regions by default, and whether the Private deployment (VPC) option supports BYOK KMS with HSM-backed keys.
- Our security counsel requests SOC 2 Type II and a recent penetration test summary prior to finalizing processor exhibits.

Attached is a clean redline from our side (cobalt_privacy_requirements.xlsx) with high-level asks. Can Redwood provide a proposed DPA redline and call out any material changes to liability and audit rights in the MSA/order form?

Timeline: procurement would like final DPA + signed order within two weeks if possible.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Khan
Head of Legal Ops, Cobalt Therapeutics

Attachments: cobalt_privacy_requirements.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Sara Khan <sara.khan@cobaltthera.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial DPA questions and hosting constraints for MSA/Order Form

Hi Sara — thanks for the clear summary and the spreadsheet. Looping in Ben and Laura (legal) and Karthik (privacy/infrastructure) to validate technical and legal asks.

Short answers up front:
- SCCs: we can incorporate the EU Commission 2021 SCCs language into the DPA and add a short transfer impact addendum (TIA). We'll surface the high-level findings in the addendum and retain technical evidence as an internal annex for audit.
- Hosting & Private: Redwood hosted default is region-aware; we can pin your tenant to EU regions. Private (VPC/on-prem) supports BYOK with KMS/HSM — there are a couple of packaging options that affect timelines (BYOK HSM provisioning adds ~2 weeks).
- Evidence: we'll provide the latest SOC 2 Type II report and our external pentest summary under NDA; I'll include an evidence checklist in our DPA redline.

Next steps proposed (action owners):
1) Redwood to send a DPA redline with SCCs + TIA stub by Thu 6 Jun — owner: Priyom.
2) Cobalt to confirm whether the order form will require Hosted (EU pinned) or Private BYOK — owner: Sara.
3) Legal review call to reconcile liability caps and audit scope — proposed slot: Fri 8 Jun 10:00-10:30 PT — owner: Laura/Ben to prepare redline summary.

Attaching an internal draft with inline notes: cobalt_dpa_redline_v1.docx (docx).

Regards,
Priyom
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: cobalt_dpa_redline_v1.docx (docx)

Subject: Re: Cobalt Therapeutics - MSA/Order Form: DPA and SCCs clarifications

Thanks for the heads-up, team. Quick legal guidance on the key items Sara raised:

- SCCs + TIA: we should adopt the 2021 SCCs text as-is and append a short Transfer Impact Addendum that documents where data will be processed, supplemental safeguards (encryption, contractual limits on onward transfers), and an operational commitment to routing EU customers to EU-hosted capacity where requested. The TIA should avoid detailed security controls in the public contract — keep those in an annex/evidence binder.
- Liability and indemnities: push for MSA liability caps to remain as negotiated; ask Cobalt for scenario examples that drive their change requests. Offer an exception path for EU sovereignty asks (e.g., Private BYOK with HSM removes certain data transfer concerns).
- Audit & evidence: agree to provide SOC 2 Type II plus a redacted pen-test. For vendor risk, we can commit to subprocessor disclosures and a 30-day notice for subprocessor changes.

Actionable checklist (legal):
[ ] Finalize DPA redline with SCCs reference and TIA stub — Ben
[ ] Confirm whether Cobalt wants Hosted-EU pinned or Private BYOK and estimate provisioning time — Karthik
[ ] Prepare a short one-page evidence index for procurement to attach to the order form — Laura

I'll draft the DPA language for liability/audit carveouts and circulate by Thursday.

Ben
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Sara Khan <sara.khan@cobaltthera.com>

Priyom,

Thanks — procurement confirms they will accept Hosted-EU pinned if the DPA includes the SCCs + TIA and the evidence binder (SOC2 + pentest). However, our legal insists on explicit processor/processor-role mapping in the DPA (controller vs processor split and subprocessor list). Michael (CookLaw) is on copy to coordinate final redlines.

We also attached the signed order form draft with a few commercial redlines (orderform_signed_draft.pdf). Note: for our pharma workloads we will evaluate Private BYOK for production later — please include an estimated cost delta if Cobalt elects BYOK/HSM.

We have a DocuSign ready for the order form if Redwood confirms the DPA redline by next Wednesday.

Sara

Sara — quick update from our side after Ben/Laura/Karthik sync this morning: 

- Ben has drafted the DPA redline with the 2021 SCCs clause and a two-page Transfer Impact Addendum that states processing locations, identified risks, and compensating safeguards (encryption at rest, access controls, contractual onward transfer limits).
- Karthik confirmed Hosted-EU pinning is an operational setting we can enable immediately; Private BYOK with HSM will require procurement of HSM slots and key-ceremony which we estimate at 10–15 business days + a one-time setup fee. I’ll send a short cost estimate separately.
- Laura is preparing the evidence index (SOC2 Type II, redacted pentest, subprocessor list).

Proposed next steps / owners:
1) Redwood to deliver final DPA redline (PDF + Word) by Mon 11 Jun EOD — Priyom/Ben.
2) Cobalt to confirm whether you want Hosted-EU pin or to begin BYOK procurement (this will determine whether DocuSign goes live this week) — Sara.
3) Joint call to review final language Tue 12 Jun 08:30 PT (Ben/Laura/Karthik/Sara/Michael) — calendar invite to follow.

I posted the DocuSign link you shared to our deal record: https://hub.redwood.com/deals/DEAL-2028-037. Please confirm and we’ll aim to return the DPA redline before your DocuSign deadline.

Thanks,
Priyom
